resolution_conditions: Use the exact J0 PR #481 merge commit and implementation head recorded in source_lock.
Review the R1 Story, Architecture, draft Spec, Task, and VibePro draft as one planning change.
Create R1 schema, fixture, source-lock, runtime, and tests only in a separate focused implementation change.
Regenerate implementation evidence at the exact combined HEAD before any completion or release decision.

forbidden: database, migrations, Graph, MCP, CLI, and HTTP
customer data, Personal body, secrets, credentials, and external sends

acceptance.statement: J0 PR #481, merge commit f8e7ac61349b326863feae5d7d3d8ae68e2b9d10, and implementation head 3fd71a1da59a85cb7cdc8cce8b17f22e3b767bde are recorded exactly; this task does not mark J0 done.
Artifact identity is a SHA-256 content address over an artifact-schema-versioned canonical payload containing the J0 source lock, run_id, and complete JudgmentDAGRunRecord.
Canonical serialization is deterministic, UTF-8, compact, recursively key-ordered, preserves semantic array order, and rejects non-JSON values, cycles, unknown fields, and truncation.
Save publishes canonical bytes atomically and idempotently without overwriting, and temporary or partial bytes are never readable as completed artifacts.
A first run_id binding is create-once; same run_id with different content or digest is a conflict with no existing artifact or binding mutation.
Reload verifies locator safety, schema, exact source lock, embedded and expected digest, canonical bytes, binding, and J0 record shape before returning a value.
Reload returns a recursively deep-frozen snapshot isolated from caller, parser, and storage mutation.
Traversal, absolute path, NUL, dot segment, symlink, non-regular file, root escape, partial write, and concurrent writer cases fail closed.
Future RED tests fail on the known pre-fix identity, canonicalization, overwrite, integrity, filesystem, concurrency, and mutation behaviors before GREEN implementation.
This planning change modifies exactly five planning files and creates no source-lock, schema, fixture, test, runtime, database, Graph, secret, customer, or deployment artifact.

negative_evidence_contract.concurrent_writer_policy: same canonical content is idempotent; different content for one run_id is conflict; last-write-wins is forbidden
negative_evidence_contract.snapshot_policy: returned envelope and record are recursively deep-frozen and storage-independent

required_suites: artifact envelope and J0 source-lock conformance
atomic publish, partial write, and concurrent writer behavior
tamper, truncation, zero-byte, unknown version, and extra-field rejection
path traversal, symlink, non-regular file, and root containment negatives
recursive deep-freeze and caller/storage mutation isolation

non_goals: historical replay or historical context reconstruction
runner version resolution, registry, migration, or compatibility decisions
outcome attachment and evaluation event-set protection
baseline-candidate version comparison, scoring, or calibration
execution log, hosted runtime, DB, Graph, MCP, CLI, HTTP, authorization, or deployment implementation
real customer data, Personal body, secrets, credentials, and external communication
